messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Issues with Rattle on R 2.12.0 on MS/Windows
parts:
I am still experiencing issues with installing Rattle on R 2.12.0 using RGtk 2.20.3 and gtk2-runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe on MS/Windows

Until these are resolved I recommend staying with R 2.11.1 for using Rattle MS/Windows.

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: f4ac9004a21f0fed
messages.subject: Re: Issues with Rattle on R 2.12.0 on MS/Windows
parts:
Dear Graham

May I suggest bundling the Rattle with R (and all dependencies) and
GTK+ and Libglade in a .MSI installer /or Windows. exe.

I know Rattle has a commercial version too- but if you can make the
.MSI Windows installer with all dependencies pre -installed it will
take away most of these issues. I suspect GTK and R 2.12 have some
issues- as Rattle is pretty stable- but the dependencies are critical
and could help with installs


Regards

Ajay

I've been doing some more testing but still not getting a R 2.12 solution yet. I think the problem is in RGtk2 but can't quite track it down specifically yet. I have an email with the RGtk2 maintainer to see if he has any suggestion.

A fresh install of R 2.12.0 and RGtk 2.20.3 and  gtk2-runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe, when loading rattle I get an error as attached.

Regards,
Graham

messages.subject: Re: Issues with Rattle on R 2.12.0 on MS/Windows
parts:
Hi Shane,

I guess it is actually trying to install gtk rather than RGtk. Try uninstalling gtk using the usual MS/Windows uninstaller, then try loading Rattle again in a new R console. RGtk2 might try installing GTK again, so select to do so, but it should be just the once.

Regards,
Graham
